register_verbatim_type: register a new VERBATIM target type with the verbatim file extension in Boost.Build
create_verbatim_scanner: create a VerbatimScanner class that overrides pattern to match include directives via regex
register_scanner_for_type: register the VerbatimScanner for include dependencies and associate it with the VERBATIM type
register_verbatim_generator: register a standard generator that converts VERBATIM targets into CPP source files
register_inline_file_action: register a build action that runs inline_file.py to process verbatim input into output
